newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong Inv sees no conflict with China Elegance.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Inv sees no conflict with China Elegance.

text.p: Guangdong Investment Ltd said on Monday it saw no conflict in its minority interest in leather garment maker China Elegance International Fashion Ltd and its spin-off of Guangdong Tannery Ltd.
"The details of the non-competition undertaking stated in the prospectus remain true and correct," the company said.
It said Guangdong Tannery mainly processes cow hides and sheep skins, which created no competition with the principal activities of China Elegance.
Guangdong Investment said it agreed to pay HK$59 million for 15 million shares or 6.25 percent of China Elegance.
A listing document stated that Guangdong Investment and its subsidiaries would not engage in any business which competes or would likely compete with the principal activities of Guangdong Tannery.
Guangdong Investment said its investment in China Elegance was passive, adding that it would not participate in the management of the group.
It also agreed to dispose of its interest in China Elegance should a conflict of interest arise.
